lesson.subject: math

misconceptionProbe.signal: Ava thinks odd numbers can have equal pairs.
misconceptionProbe.checkPrompt: If 5 robots have partners, is one robot left alone?
misconceptionProbe.expectedConfusion: Thinking every number can be split into two equal groups without leftovers.

blocks.title: Robot Teams
blocks.prompt: Ava, let's help robots find partners to explore the stars!

blocks.title: What is Even?
blocks.prompt: Even numbers mean every robot has a partner. No robot is lonely.

blocks.title: Partner Match
blocks.prompt: Count the robots. Can they all have a partner?

blocks.title: Star Check
blocks.prompt: There are 7 stars. Is 7 even or odd?

blocks.title: Learning Progress
blocks.prompt: Ava is learning to identify even and odd numbers using pairs.

hintLadder.text: Draw a circle around groups of two robots.
Is there one robot left over without a friend?
4 is even because 2+2=4. Try it with 6!

lesson.parentSummary: Ava practiced identifying even and odd numbers by pairing robot characters and checking for leftovers.
